name: com.sooyoungjang.debuglibrary.presentation.view.ui.overlay.OverlayTaskService
description: The VisibleDebugTool visible_logcat library starts this service when its floating log viewer is enabled. It places the live log panel over other apps and handles searches from that panel.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the floating log panel and its search and clear controls, while the host app continues to work normally.
